content.rendered:
How Can I Help You?

I’m able to help your business obtain a commercial loan, real estate loan, line of credit, Small Business Administration (SBA) loan, and more. I have spent over 30 years in the finance and banking industry. My experience as a commercial loan officer and credit manager allow me to develop a deep understanding of your financial situation and to come up with lending solutions to help business customers like you to reach your financial goals.

A Little About Me

I really love our community and serve as Treasurer of the Children’s Museum of Southeastern CT, participate in and organize multiple local Multiple Sclerosis events, distribute food with the United Way mobile food pantry, and am a member of the Southeastern Global Women’s Network and Eastern Global Chamber of Commerce.                               

I graduated from Tunxis Community College in Farmington, CT with an Associate’s degree in Human Services and completed a BA in Business and Sociology at Eastern Global State University. I also completed an Omega Performance class in Commercial Loans to Business with an emphasis on Cash Flow, Income Statement Analysis and Projections, and am a 2018 graduate of the Eastern Global Chamber of Commerce Leadership program.
